title: Atlas Configuration
description: Defines version-one Atlas workspace discovery, artifact, and layout policy.

schemaVersion.description: Identifies the supported Atlas configuration schema version.

discovery.description: Defines package discovery and explicit classification policy.

packageGlobs.description: Matches package directories relative to the workspace root.

excludePackageGlobs.description: Excludes package directories before policy matching.

defaultSourceRoots.description: Defines source roots used when package policies do not override them.

packages.description: Defines explicit classification policies for included packages.

rows.description: Limits sibling items in each generated row.

horizontalGap.description: Defines the minimum horizontal gap between item bounds.

verticalGap.description: Defines the minimum vertical gap between item bounds.

diagrams.description: Defines generated diagram graph-shaping policy and opt-in folder scopes.

rules.description: Declares architecture policies Atlas evaluates during validation.

layers.description: Defines optional named source layers for dependency direction rules.

diagramConfiguration.description: Configures generated diagram inclusion and external-dependency rendering.

moduleGroups.description: Defines presentation-only groups that collapse matching canonical artifact module IDs.

excludeSourceGlobs.description: Excludes local declarations whose workspace-relative source paths match a glob.

excludeExternalDependencies.description: Excludes external dependency labels matching a glob.

collapseExternalDependencies.description: Collapses visible external dependencies to package-level nodes.

collapseExternalDependencyGlobs.description: Collapses matching external dependency labels when global collapsing is disabled.

splitExternalDependenciesByImporter.description: Splits landscape external dependencies by importing workspace package.

externalDependencyImporterSplits.description: Selectively splits matching landscape external dependencies by importing package.

folderDiagramConfiguration.description: Configures one package-local folder diagram with inherited or overridden graph policy.

packageName.description: Names the explicitly discovered package that owns the folder.

path.description: Names a normalized folder path relative to the package root.

title.description: Optionally overrides the generated folder diagram title.

excludeSourceGlobs.description: Adds source-node exclusions to inherited graph policy.

excludeExternalDependencies.description: Adds external dependency exclusions to inherited graph policy.

collapseExternalDependencies.description: Optionally overrides inherited external collapse behavior.

splitExternalDependenciesByImporter.description: Optionally overrides inherited external splitting behavior.

externalDependencyImporterSplits.description: Adds selective external dependency importer splits to inherited policy.

moduleGroupConfiguration.description: Defines one stable presentation-only artifact module group.

id.description: Stable group identity used in diagram and layout scope IDs.

title.description: Human-readable title shown for the presentation group.

moduleIdPatterns.description: Lists glob patterns matched against opaque artifact module IDs.

externalDependencyImporterSplit.description: Splits one external dependency for selected importing workspace packages.

dependency.description: Matches one external dependency label using a glob pattern.

packageNames.description: Names importing workspace packages receiving separate dependency nodes.

packageDiagramConfiguration.description: Configures source-node exclusions for one explicitly discovered package.

packageName.description: Names the explicitly discovered package that owns the declarations.

excludeSourceGlobs.description: Adds source-node exclusions for declarations in this package.

packagePolicy.description: Classifies one selected package and its source roots.

classification.description: Identifies runtime or support package membership.

classes.description: Adds stable user-defined package class labels.

sourceRoots.description: Overrides default source roots relative to the package root.

tsconfig.description: Names an optional TypeScript configuration file relative to the package root.

packageMatch.description: Matches a package manifest name, directory path, or both.

name.description: Matches a package manifest name using a glob pattern.

path.description: Matches a workspace-relative package directory path using a glob pattern.

architectureRule.description: Defines one supported architecture validation rule.

noCircularRule.description: Rejects circular dependencies reported by the analysis adapter.

id.description: Uniquely identifies this rule in the configuration document.

severity.description: Determines whether violations fail the command.

noRuntimeToSupportRule.description: Rejects dependencies from runtime packages to support packages.

id.description: Uniquely identifies this rule in the configuration document.

severity.description: Determines whether violations fail the command.

dependencyDirectionRule.description: Restricts dependency directions between selected packages or layers.

mode.description: Allows only selected targets or forbids selected targets.

from.description: Optionally selects importing packages or layers.
Optionally selects importing packages or layers.

ruleSelector.description: Selects packages and source paths by package names, classes, or layers.

moduleIds.description: Matches opaque artifact module IDs; package names remain compatible aliases.

layerDefinition.description: Defines a named workspace-relative source layer.

sourceGlobs.description: Lists workspace-relative source path globs in the layer.

packageNames.description: Optionally limits the layer to exact discovered package names.
